description:
I am an engineering student at UTAS Muscat, Oman, passionate about AI, satellite data, sustainability, and entrepreneurship. I am working on a NASA Space Apps project to help farmers improve crop rotation, soil health, and water efficiency using NASA data.

I welcome motivated teammates interested in solving real-world problems. I am looking for skills in agriculture, data analysis, AI, web development, and UI/UX design. Let’s combine our skills to impactful solution.
